text.p: The European meals and feeds market started quietly after the three-day Whitsun weekend with sellers offering nearby material of most products slightly up from Friday's midday levels, market sources said.
Despite a weaker dollar little buying interest was reported this morning and no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"Sellers were offering most products a couple of dollars up on the back of last night's Chicago soymeal futures and a weaker dollar. But the lack of faith in the market, which kept a lid on activity most of last week, continued to rule," one broker said. --KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
